NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Sellify uses your location to fill in the right city in your listings.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Sellify uses the microphone so you can describe your item with your voice.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Sellify needs access to your photos so you can add pictures to your listings.
NSCameraUsageDescription: Sellify uses the camera to photograph items for your listings.
